title: Nisa Parveen v. State of U.P.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; Clause 6.5 objection to be decided in twelve weeks.
headnote: A writ seeking a direction to decide an electricity-bill objection is disposed of by directing the concerned authority to treat the objection as an application under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and decide it within twelve weeks by a reasoned order after hearing the consumer.
facts: Nisa Parveen approached the Allahabad High Court under Article 226 seeking a mandamus to respondent No. 2 to decide her objection dated 13 March 2025 to an electricity bill. Counsel submitted that the objection should be treated as an application under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and decided expeditiously. The State and counsel for respondents 2 and 3 were heard. The Court did not examine the bill on merits.

holding_units.holding: The authority is directed to decide the petitioner's electricity-bill objection, treating it as an application under Clause 6.5 of the Supply Code, 2005, within twelve weeks by a reasoned order after granting an opportunity of hearing. The writ is disposed of without examining the merits of the bill.

not_decided.note: Left to the concerned authority to decide under Clause 6.5.
